notes.title: Multiplayer & Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey friends, the Cooperative Mode is released!

Call all your friends and acquaintances, go from poor Russians to Foreign Agents together!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/6ad303f3b1c3f1efc3183b1fbee5cbf9643a4a73.png

Also we released a Big Hotfix Patch, it was fixed a huge number of small bugs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/327a6c37cb0734039d3ab3e8f39a5b13d56b2fd8.png

Vladimir Putin and Joe Biden look forward to seeing you and your friends in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36544876/63281d179cba306d9d1af2ac22e0fc2896efefcb.png

Thank you!
